description: Adapted TUM LIKE workload: the 60 patterns for upstream IMDB/quotes from the DaMoN'26 FSST-LIKE benchmark (https://github.com/calin2110/FSST-LIKE-Matching@b1eb3ab9c63e), stored under the narrowest equivalent op and blessed against OUR column imdb-quotes-frozen-1m — not an exact reproduction of the paper's data. Underscore groups 0/1/>=2 are kept in meta.tum.
